service.name: Live music for a retirement party
service.serviceType: A jazz duo, a singer with a guitar, live band karaoke, a party band or a DJ for retirement parties thrown by a company or a family
service.description: Live music for a retirement party across Denver and the Front Range: a jazz duo playing the standards at 65 to 72 dBA under the dinner and silent for the speeches, a singer with a guitar who learns the retiree's song for the night, live band karaoke for the department, and a trio or quartet for the send-off that ends on a floor, at home, at a club, in a restaurant's private dining space or at the office, with an announcement microphone for the speeches, vendor paperwork where a company needs it, and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can we hire a band for a retirement party?
faqs.a: Yes. Most start with a jazz duo or one guitarist under the dinner, a singer with a guitar plays the retiree's song, live band karaoke gets the department singing, and a trio or a quartet plays the send-off that dances. It's one contract with one personal contact, booked through Signet Artists in Denver.

faqs.q: How does the music work around the speeches?
faqs.a: The duo plays at the level of the conversation, stops for each speech and comes back the moment the glass goes down, and an announcement microphone is live for whoever stands up. Tell us roughly when the speeches fall and the set is built around them.

faqs.q: Can the company pay by purchase order?
faqs.a: Yes. A company's retirement dinner is booked like any corporate event: vendor setup, a purchase order, a certificate of insurance and a W-9 are all available. Procurement is rarely fast, so start early.

faqs.q: How much space does the band need in a private dining space?
faqs.a: One guitar takes about 6 by 4 feet on one circuit, a duo 8 by 6, a trio 12 by 8, and a quartet or live band karaoke 14 by 10 on two circuits, with karaoke's two lyric screens. Setup runs 45 minutes for a solo and an hour for a duo or a trio, and we settle setup, power and volume with the venue before the day.
